children: Fresh from its launch in the United Arab Emirates in October, Le Must, the prestige single-serve condiments and preserves brand endorsed by Forbes Travel Guide, today announced its official launch in Europe.

The brand will make its European debut at Les Places d'Or, Hotel & Restaurant, the selective trade show for luxury hotels and fine dining, held November 23, 24 and 25, 2026 in the salons of the Hôtel Le Meurice in Paris. The European business is led by Le Must Europe, based in Paris, with Oshibori Concept as distributor and launch partner.

Le Must built its reputation in the United States, Mexico and the Caribbean, where it is served at Forbes Five-Star hotels and resorts including Four Seasons, The Ritz-Carlton, Mandarin Oriental, Waldorf Astoria and St. Regis, as well as aboard luxury cruise lines and private jets. The brand is endorsed by Forbes Travel Guide through Astria. Europe is the next step in the brand's global expansion.

Le Must's condiments and preserves are made in France, and every product is designed to elevate the guest experience while respecting the planet. The brand is leading the move to plastic-free and biocompostable materials in single-serve packaging, beginning with its biocompostable sugar packets, making it both the ultimate luxury single-serve brand and the most eco-friendly one. American favorites will follow, including the hot sauces and maple syrup that rank among the brand's top sellers. Le Must products were also recently featured in VIP hospitality lounges at select international motorsport events in Europe.

“European hoteliers set the standard for hospitality, and they know a guest remembers the smallest details of a stay,” said Moshe Cohen, President of Le Must Europe. “We are proud to present Le Must at Le Meurice and to offer Europe's finest hotels a collection that is as responsible as it is refined.” Oshibori Concept, the Paris house founded by Franck Salama that creates luxury refreshing towels for prestige hotels and restaurants, will distribute Le Must and lead its promotion across the European market.

“Oshibori Concept was created to give exceptional hotels a gesture of welcome worthy of them, and Le Must brings that same philosophy to the breakfast table,” said Franck Salama, Founder and CEO of Oshibori Concept. “Beauty, quality and responsibility: it is exactly what European hoteliers are looking for.”

Now in its fourth edition, Les Places d'Or, Hotel & Restaurant gathers some fifty high-end brands before a selected audience of hoteliers, restaurateurs, architects, interior designers and investors. The show is open from 4:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. each day, and industry professionals can request an invitation at visiterhotel.lesplacesdor.com.

Le Must creates prestige single-serve condiments and preserves for the world's finest hotels, resorts, luxury cruise lines and private aviation operators. The brand is endorsed by Forbes Travel Guide through Astria and is committed to plastic-free, biocompostable packaging. Le Must Europe, based in Paris, leads the brand's business in Europe. Learn more at www.lemust.com.
Oshibori Concept is a Paris house that creates luxury refreshing towels for prestige hotels, restaurants and events.
Founded by Franck Salama, it is the European distributor and launch partner of Le Must. www.oshiboriconcept.com

title: Le Must Launches in Europe at Les Places d'Or, Hôtel Le Meurice
